Total count may be the sum of per-room container multiplicities, but saved data does not prove the same formula predicts a derelict before traversal.
For some fixed system/preset pairs, count may be stable without observing root; cross-system, same-build evidence is needed before excluding root generally.

The two same-address snapshots nine days apart may reflect a time/session-dependent derelict state or capture-version/scene-enumeration differences; distinguish these only with executable-pinned runtime evidence and an independently observed count.
